outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED ACROSS PARTS OF THE CENTRAL PLAINS AND MIDDLE MISSOURI RIVER VALLEY ON SATURDAY...WITH OTHER STRONG STORMS POSSIBLE ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN ROCKIES...HIGH PLAINS AND UPPER MIDWEST.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AS A SWRN U.S. UPPER LOW WEAKENS AS IT DRIFTS NEWD AND A TROUGH INVOF THE E COAST MOVES OFFSHORE INTO THE ATLANTIC DURING THE DAY...WEAKENING OF THE CENTRAL U.S. RIDGE IS PROGGED. THIS WEAKENING WILL BE FACILITATED BY NRN STREAM SHORT-WAVE TROUGHING...PROGGED TO SHIFT ESEWD ACROSS THE CANADIAN PRAIRIE AND NRN PLAINS. AT THE SURFACE...A COOL FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH THE AFOREMENTIONED NRN STREAM TROUGH IS FORECAST TO SHIFT SEWD OUT OF CANADA INTO/ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS THROUGH THE PERIOD.

sections.title: NRN AND CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: MODERATE AFTERNOON DESTABILIZATION IS PROGGED ACROSS THE NRN AND CENTRAL PLAINS...WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR OF A SEWD-MOVING COOL FRONT. AS HEIGHT FALLS OVERSPREAD THE AREA AND THE BACKGROUND RIDGING WEAKENS IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE ADVANCING NRN STREAM TROUGH...STORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED TO OCCUR DURING THE AFTERNOON ACROSS THE DAKOTAS ALONG THE ADVANCING FRONT. STORMS MAY ALSO DEVELOP ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS OF NERN CO...WHILE OTHER CONVECTION SHOULD EVENTUALLY DEVELOP INVOF THE NW-SE WARM FRONT INVOF THE MID MO VALLEY OF ERN NEB/WRN IA. WITH MODERATE MID-LEVEL WLYS ACROSS THIS REGION ON THE ORDER OF 25-35 KT ATOP A SLY LOW-LEVEL JET...SHEAR WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED/ROTATING STORMS. THE GREATEST RISK FOR A COUPLE OF TORNADOES SHOULD EXIST INVOF THE WARM FRONT -- I.E. ACROSS ERN NEB/WRN IA THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. OTHERWISE...DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE...WITH AN MCS POSSIBLY DEVELOPING BY EVENING ACROSS THE MID MO VALLEY AND SHIFTING EWD TOWARD THE UPPER MS VALLEY OVERNIGHT.

sections.title: CENTRAL AND SRN ROCKIES AREA
sections.text: MODEST DESTABILIZATION IS FORECAST FROM THE FOUR CORNERS AREA ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND SRN ROCKIES...AHEAD OF THE WEAKENING UPPER LOW PROGGED TO DRIFT NEWD ACROSS SRN NV INTO UT WITH TIME. WITH A BELT OF ENHANCED MID-LEVEL SWLYS /ON THE ORDER OF 40 TO 50 KT/ ACROSS THE FOUR CORNERS STATES...A FEW ORGANIZED STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE FROM MID AFTERNOON THROUGH MID EVENING. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN RISKS. ..GOSS.. 06/06/2015

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH THE RISK FOR LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED ACROSS PARTS OF THE CENTRAL PLAINS AND MIDDLE MISSOURI RIVER VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY TONIGHT. OTHER STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS THE EASTERN DAKOTAS...AS WELL AS THE FOUR CORNERS AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: MID MO VALLEY TO ERN DAKOTAS THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A CLOSED LOW WILL DRIFT NEWD FROM SRN NV TO SW UT...WHILE A RIDGE PERSISTS OVER THE SRN PLAINS. MEANWHILE...A NRN STREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL BEGIN TO AMPLIFY OVER THE DAKOTAS/MN...AS AN ASSOCIATED WEAK SURFACE LOW DEVELOPS EWD FROM THE SD/ND BORDER REGION INTO CENTRAL MN BY TONIGHT. LARGELY ELEVATED CONVECTION IS ONGOING ACROSS WRN/CENTRAL ND IN ADVANCE OF THE NRN STREAM TROUGH...AS WELL AS FARTHER S INTO NE KS/NW MO/SE NEB IN A ZONE OF LOW-LEVEL WAA. THE ND CONVECTION WILL LIKELY CONTINUE IN SOME FORM THROUGH THE DAY...WHICH WILL LIMIT LAPSE RATES AND SURFACE HEATING WITH NWD EXTENT IN ND. SOME CLOUD BREAKS AND BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MODEST DESTABILIZATION INTO ERN SD AND SE ND...WHERE CONVECTION COULD STRENGTHEN THIS AFTERNOON. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR AT LEAST A MARGINAL SUPERCELL RISK...AND STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS. THE MORE FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR SUPERCELLS IS EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING ACROSS NE NEB/SE SD/NW IA...IN THE WAKE OF THE WEAKENING MORNING CONVECTION. THERE ARE SOME CONCERNS ABOUT LINGERING CLOUDS AND RATHER MODEST LAPSE RATES/MOISTURE BASED ON 12Z SOUNDINGS. STILL...SURFACE

sections.title: NE CO THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: THE LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME WILL WEAKEN TODAY IN RESPONSE TO CYCLOGENESIS OVER THE NRN PLAINS. MOISTURE WILL ALSO BE REDUCED COMPARED TO THE PREVIOUS TWO DAYS. STILL...MLCAPE COULD REACH 1000-1500 J/KG WITH DAYTIME HEATING/MIXING THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS NE CO. DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS BENEATH THE BELT OF ENHANCED MID-UPPER SWLY FLOW OVER CO. A FEW STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP NEAR AND E OF THE FRONT RANGE...AND PERHAPS OVER THE PALMER DIVIDE...BY EARLY-MID AFTERNOON AS DAYTIME HEATING PHASES WITH THE APPROACH OF AN INFERRED BAND OF ASCENT FROM NE AZ/WRN CO PER WV IMAGERY. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY CONCERNS WITH THE STRONGER STORMS OVER NE CO IN THE 21-00Z TIME FRAME.

sections.title: FOUR CORNERS TODAY
sections.text: CONVECTION IS ONGOING OVER CENTRAL/NE AZ WITHIN A PLUME OF ENHANCED LOW-MIDLEVEL MOISTURE AND ASCENT...IMMEDIATELY E OF THE CLOSED LOW OVER SRN NV. VERTICAL SHEAR IS ALSO RATHER STRONG IN THIS SAME CORRIDOR...WHICH WILL SPREAD SLOWLY NEWD THROUGH THE DAY. POCKETS OF SURFACE HEATING WITHIN CLOUD BREAKS WILL LOCALLY BOOST BUOYANCY IN AN ENVIRONMENT WITH LONG HODOGRAPHS AND SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS. THUS...THE STRONGER STORMS WILL POSE A RISK FOR ISOLATED STRONG/DAMAGING GUSTS AND HAIL. ..THOMPSON/COOK.. 06/06/2015

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH THE RISK FOR LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND ISOLATED TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED ACROSS PARTS OF THE CENTRAL PLAINS AND MIDDLE MISSOURI RIVER VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY TONIGHT. OTHER STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS THE EASTERN DAKOTAS...AS WELL AS THE FOUR CORNERS AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: NEB/IA/SD
sections.text: FEW CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE ONGOING OUTLOOK. RECENT CAM SOLUTIONS SEEM TO HAVE REASONABLE HANDLE ON ONGOING CONVECTIVE CLUSTER OVER EASTERN NEB...AND SUGGEST CONVECTIVE DEBRIS WILL MOVE OUT OF REGION BY EARLY AFTERNOON. RELATIVELY STRONG HEATING WILL ENSUE...WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MID/UPPER 60S AND STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES LEADING TO MLCAPE VALUES OVER 2500 J/KG. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW SUBSTANTIAL LOW LEVEL SHEAR AS WIND FIELDS INCREASING THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING...PROVIDING A FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR SUPERCELL STORMS. CONSIDERED A SMALL 10 PERCENT TORNADO RISK AREA OVER FAR NORTHEAST NEB/NORTHWEST IA GIVEN VERY CONSISTENT MULTI-MODEL AGREEMENT ON A CLUSTER OF INTENSE STORMS...BUT HAVE OPTED TO WAIT FOR FURTHER GUIDANCE AT 20Z UPDATE. STORMS MAY GROW UPSCALE AND BUILD EASTWARD INTO PARTS OF IA THIS EVENING WITH A CONTINUED RISK OF WIND/HAIL.

sections.title: ERN CO INTO WRN KS/EB
sections.text: LOW LEVEL WINDS ARE MORE VEERED COMPARED TO THE LAST FEW DAYS OVER EASTERN CO AND WESTERN KS. THUNDERSTORMS ARE STILL EXPECTED TO FORM IN THIS REGION LATER TODAY...MOVING OFF THE FOOTHILLS INTO THE PLAINS AND EVENTUALLY ACROSS PARTS OF WESTERN KS/NEB. VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES CONTINUE TO SUPPORT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. HOWEVER...A DEEPER MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AND MORE WESTERLY COMPONENT TO LOW LEVEL WINDS WILL PREFER AN EVOLUTION TOWARD BOWING STRUCTURES WITH WIND AND HAIL LIKELY THE MAIN THREATS.

sections.title: ND/SD/MN
sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOPS SHOW A STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING INTO NORTHWEST ND. THIS FEATURE WILL PROVIDE LARGE SCALE ASCENT AND AID IN CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON ALONG A COLD FRONT MOVING INTO EASTERN ND. SUBSTANTIAL CLOUD COVER IS PRESENT THIS MORNING IN THIS AREA...WHICH WILL LIMIT DESTABILIZATION AND OVERALL SEVERE THREAT. HOWEVER...ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE WITH HAIL/WIND RISKS AS STORMS SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD INTO NORTHEAST SD AND WESTERN MN. ..HART/GLEASON.. 06/06/2015

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH THE RISK FOR LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED ACROSS PARTS OF THE CENTRAL PLAINS AND MIDDLE MISSOURI RIVER VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY TONIGHT. OTHER STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS THE EASTERN DAKOTAS...AS WELL AS THE FOUR CORNERS AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: PRIMARY CHANGES TO THE DAY-1 CONVECTIVE OUTLOOK
sections.text: /1/ TORNADO PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN INCREASED TO 10 PERCENT ACROSS PORTIONS OF NERN NEB...SERN SD...AND ADJACENT EXTREME WRN IA. TSTMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS FROM PARTS OF CNTRL NEB INTO S-CNTRL SD WHERE VIS IMAGERY SUGGESTS THE BOUNDARY-LAYER CUMULUS FIELD IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY AGITATED. POLEWARD FLUXES OF RICH MOISTURE S OF A MIGRATORY SFC CYCLONE OVER THE NRN PLAINS ARE FOSTERING AN INFLUX/MAINTENANCE OF UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS FROM THE SOUTH...BOLSTERING DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION. THE VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE SAMPLED BY THE UEX/FSD VWPS SUGGESTS THAT TSTMS WILL LIKELY EVOLVE INTO SUPERCELL/SUPERCELL CLUSTERS. A PERSISTENT...AND STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET WILL BOLSTER LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPH LENGTH/CURVATURE IN SUPPORT OF TORNADOES ACROSS THE FOCUSED AREA WHERE TORNADO PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN INCREASED. LOW-LEVEL SRH IS EXPECTED TO BE SUFFICIENT TO RESULT IN A RISK FOR SIGNIFICANT TORNADOES. PLEASE SEE SWOMCD 912 FOR FURTHER DETAILS. /2/ THE 5-PERCENT TORNADO AREA WAS EXTENDED NWD INTO FAR SERN ND AND PORTIONS OF WRN MN WHERE DESTABILIZATION HAS BEEN MORE MODEST AMIDST CLOUDS. HOWEVER...LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR ROTATING TSTMS WITH SOME TORNADO R

sections.text: FEW CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE ONGOING OUTLOOK. RECENT CAM SOLUTIONS SEEM TO HAVE REASONABLE HANDLE ON ONGOING CONVECTIVE CLUSTER OVER EASTERN NEB...AND SUGGEST CONVECTIVE DEBRIS WILL MOVE OUT OF REGION BY EARLY AFTERNOON. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW SUBSTANTIAL LOW LEVEL SHEAR AS WIND FIELDS INCREASING THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING...PROVIDING A FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR SUPERCELL STORMS. STORMS MAY GROW UPSCALE AND BUILD EASTWARD INTO PARTS OF IA THIS EVENING WITH A CONTINUED RISK OF WIND/HAIL.

THUNDERSTORMS ARE STILL EXPECTED TO FORM IN THIS REGION LATER TODAY...MOVING OFF THE FOOTHILLS INTO THE PLAINS AND EVENTUALLY ACROSS PARTS OF WESTERN KS/NEB. HOWEVER...A DEEPER MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AND MORE WESTERLY COMPONENT TO LOW LEVEL WINDS WILL PREFER AN EVOLUTION TOWARD BOWING STRUCTURES WITH WIND AND HAIL LIKELY THE MAIN THREATS.

sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOPS SHOW A STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING INTO NORTHWEST ND. THIS FEATURE WILL PROVIDE LARGE SCALE ASCENT AND AID IN CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON ALONG A COLD FRONT MOVING INTO EASTERN ND. SUBSTANTIAL CLOUD COVER IS PRESENT THIS MORNING IN THIS AREA...WHICH WILL LIMIT DESTABILIZATION AND OVERALL SEVERE THREAT. HOWEVER...ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE WITH HAIL/WIND RISKS AS STORMS SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD INTO NORTHEAST SD AND WESTERN MN.

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH THE RISK FOR LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND A TORNADO THREAT ARE EXPECTED ACROSS PARTS OF THE CENTRAL PLAINS AND MIDDLE MISSOURI RIVER VALLEY THIS EVENING. A LARGE CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS IS EXPECTED TO MOVE EASTWARD ACROSS PARTS OF EASTERN NEBRASKA...SOUTHERN MINNESOTA...AND MUCH OF IOWA LATER THIS EVENING THROUGH EARLY SUNDAY MORNING...WITH DAMAGING WINDS BEING THE PRIMARY THREAT. OTHER STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE YET THIS EVENING ACROSS THE SOUTHERN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS AND IN VICINITY OF THE FOUR CORNERS.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST/MID MO VALLEY TO THE UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: ALL SEVERE HAZARDS ARE EXPECTED WITH THE ONGOING STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ACROSS NERN NEB AND SERN SD WITH ACTIVITY SPREADING INTO SWRN MN AND NWRN IA. CAPE/SHEAR PARAMETER SPACE WILL BECOME MORE FAVORABLE FOR AN INCREASE IN ADDITIONAL ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS AS A SWLY LLJ STRENGTHENS THIS EVENING FROM KS/ERN NEB TO THE UPPER MS VALLEY...WHILE WLY MIDLEVEL WINDS STRENGTHEN AS WELL. THESE LATTER FACTORS WILL RESULT IN AN INCREASE OF BULK SHEAR WHILE SRH INCREASES ALONG THE LLJ WITH 0-3 KM SRH OF 300-400 M2/S2 FOR A TORNADO THREAT PERSISTING UNTIL AROUND MID-LATE EVENING. CURRENT THINKING SUGGESTS A FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS WILL EVOLVE THIS EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF IA AND SRN MN...MOST LIKELY FROM THE ONGOING CLUSTER OF STORMS IN NERN NEB/SERN SD. THIS MCS SHOULD BE SUSTAINED BY AN INCREASE IN DEEP-LAYER ASCENT ATTENDANT TO LOW-LEVEL WAA ALONG THE NOSE OF THE LLJ INTO THIS REGION AND INCREASING MID-LEVEL FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO A PROGRESSIVE MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH...CURRENTLY LOCATED OVER CENTRAL NEB/KS. MEANWHILE...DESPITE WEAK INSTABILITY WITH EWD EXTENT OVER ERN IA PER 00Z DVN SOUNDING...LOW-LEVEL MOISTENING AND WAA ALONG THE LLJ INTO IA/SRN MN SHOULD SUPPORT

sections.title: NERN SD/SERN ND/WRN AND CENTRAL MN
sections.text: WEAK INSTABILITY WITH EWD EXTENT INTO ERN MN PER 00Z MPX SOUNDING AND DIABATIC COOLING ACROSS THE NRN EXTENT OF THE SLIGHT RISK AREA SUGGESTS THE OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT ACROSS THESE AREAS SHOULD DIMINISH. FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS...PLEASE REFER TO SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 916.

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: RESIDUAL INSTABILITY AND SUFFICIENT BULK SHEAR SUGGEST STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THIS EVENING ALONG THE SWD-MOVING COLD FRONT IN CENTRAL AND WRN NEB...AND ALONG BOUNDARY INTERACTIONS IN PARTS OF ERN CO AND NWRN KS. ..PETERS.. 06/07/2015

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS ECNTRL NM. HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS AS CELLS GRADUALLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY. DUE TO THE ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREATS...WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED ACROSS ECNTRL NM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A LEE TROUGH FROM ERN CO EXTENDING SWD ACROSS THE NWRN TX PANHANDLE AND SWWD INTO ERN NM. SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE UPPER 50S NEAR THE SFC TROUGH WHICH HAS ALLOWED A SMALL POCKET OF MODERATE INSTABILITY TO DEVELOP AS SFC TEMPS HAVE WARMED LATE THIS MORNING INTO THIS AFTERNOON. THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING IN THE CAPITAN MTNS OF SE NM WITH OTHER CONVECTION DEVELOPING TO THE EAST OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN IN NCNTRL NM. IN ADDITION TO THE STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES EVIDENT ON THE AMARILLO 12Z SOUNDING...THE WSR-88D VWP AT ALBUQUERQUE SHOWS 35 TO 40 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR WITH SOME DIRECTIONAL SHEAR IN THE LOW TO MID-LEVELS. THIS ENVIRONMENT SHOULD BE ENOUGH TO CONTINUE AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT THIS AFTERNOON WITH THE STRONGER MULTICELLS. HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS AS THE STORMS MATURE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. SOME OF THESE THUNDERSTORMS WILL POSE A MARGINAL RISK FOR ISOLATED INSTANCES OF LARGE HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS. WW ISSUANCE IS NOT EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED CONVECTION HAS DEVELOPED IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE LIFT PROVIDED BY AN UPPER JET ON THE ERN SIDE OF A CLOSED LOW NOW CENTERED OVER SRN NV. AMIDST SOME BREAKS IN CLOUD COVER...SFC TEMPERATURES ACROSS THE MCD AREA HAVE GENERALLY WARMED INTO THE 60S AND 70S. COMBINED WITH RATHER MOIST LOW-LEVELS FOR THIS REGION...INDICATED BY SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 40S TO LOWER 50S...MLCAPE HAS INCREASED INTO THE 500-1000 J/KG RANGE PER RAP FORECAST SOUNDINGS AND BY MODIFYING THE 12Z SOUNDING FROM FGZ FOR CURRENT CONDITIONS. ENHANCED MIDLEVEL FLOW CONTINUES ACROSS THE FOUR CORNERS REGION...WITH AREA VWPS SAMPLING A VEERING WIND PROFILE WITH HEIGHT AND 40-55 KT AROUND 6 KM AGL. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 35-45 KT SHOULD BE ADEQUATE TO SUSTAIN ROTATING UPDRAFTS WITH THE STRONGER CORES. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN SEVERE WEATHER THREATS THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING...BEFORE THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING REDUCES INSTABILITY AND LESSENS THE SEVERE RISK. IN ADDITION...A BRIEF/ISOLATED TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT GIVEN THE VEERING LOW-LEVEL WIND PROFILE. REGARDLESS...DUE TO THE MARGINAL RISK FOR SEVERE WEATHER ACROSS THIS REGION...A WW IS NOT EXPECTED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS ERN SD AND NE NEB OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. LARGE HAIL...WIND DAMAGE AND A FEW TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER THUNDERSTORMS. WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE REGION BY 20Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A 1006 MB LOW OVER NCNTRL SD WITH A SFC TROUGH EXTENDING SWWD INTO WRN NEB. SLY FLOW IS LOCATED TO THE EAST OF THE TROUGH WHERE A MOIST AIRMASS IS IN PLACE WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S AND LOWER 70S F. THIS IS CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS SRN SD AND ECNTRL NEB WHERE MLCAPE IS ESTIMATED FROM 1000 TO 2000 J/KG ACCORDING TO MESOANALYSIS DATA. IN ADDITION...A VORTICITY MAX IS EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. AS THE VORT MAX APPROACHES FROM THE SOUTHWEST...LARGE-SCALE ASCENT WILL BECOME ENHANCED ACROSS NCNTRL NEB AND SRN SD...AIDING CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. SHORT-TERM MODEL SOLUTIONS SUGGEST THUNDERSTORMS WILL INITIATE BY 20Z JUST AHEAD OF THE SFC TROUGH IN NCNTRL NEB AND MOVE EWD ACROSS NERN NEB AND FAR SERN SD LATE THIS AFTERNOON. THE WSR-88D VWP AT OMAHA SHOWS AN IMPRESSIVE SHEAR ENVIRONMENT WITH STRONG DIRECTIONAL SHEAR BELOW 4 KM AND 0-6 KM SHEAR NEAR 40 KT. THIS ALONG WITH THE INSTABILITY SHOULD SUPPORT SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT WITH LARGE HAIL. AS LOW-LEVEL SHEAR INCREASES ACROSS NE NEB LATE THIS AFTERNOON DUE TO A STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET...TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MORE DOMINANT SUPERCELLS. WIND DAMAGE MAY ALSO OCCUR WITH SUPERCELLS AND BOWING LINE SEGMENTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP ACROSS SE ND AND NE SD OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HAIL AND ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE ARE LIKELY TO BE THE PRIMARY THREATS ALTHOUGH A TORNADO CAN NOT BE TOTALLY RULED OUT. WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE REGION THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A 1006 MB LOW OVER NCNTRL SD WITH A COLD FRONT ADVANCING SEWD ACROSS CNTRL ND AND WCNTRL SD. A CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS LOCATED ACROSS ECNTRL SD INTO SE ND WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE GENERALLY IN THE MID 60S F AND A POCKET OF MODERATE INSTABILITY COULD DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTERNOON. SHORT-TERM MODELS INCLUDING THE HRRR INITIATE STORMS ALONG AND JUST AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT MOVING THIS CONVECTION EWD ACROSS THE MCD AREA LATE THIS AFTERNOON. WSR-88D VWPS AT GRAND FORKS AND ABERDEEN SHOW 0-6 KM SHEAR NEAR 40 KT WHICH SHOULD ENABLE SOME OF THE CELLS TO ORGANIZE. ROTATING STORMS WITH HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WHERE CELLS HAVE ACCESS TO THE GREATEST INSTABILITY. HOWEVER...CONVECTION MAY TEND TO LINE UP ALONG THE COLD FRONT WHICH WOULD MAKE WIND DAMAGE POSSIBLE ESPECIALLY WITH BOWING LINE SEGMENTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT...INCLUDING A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...SHOULD INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON. WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WITH THE APPROACH OF A MID-LEVEL SPEED MAXIMUM OVER THE FOUR CORNERS REGION...CONVECTION HAS RECENTLY INITIATED OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF ERN CO AND SERN WY. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY DEPICTS SOME CLEARING HAS OCCURRED SINCE THIS MORNING ACROSS THE MCD AREA...WITH SFC TEMPERATURES NOW GENERALLY IN THE UPPER 70S TO LOWER 80S. AS DIURNAL HEATING CONTINUES THROUGH THE AFTERNOON ALONG A SFC LEE TROUGH SITUATED OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS...THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD MOVE EWD FROM THE HIGHER TERRAIN TO PORTIONS OF ERN CO...AND EVENTUALLY NWRN KS AND THE SWRN NEB PANHANDLE WHERE MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG WILL RESIDE. LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS MORE WLY TODAY COMPARED TO PREVIOUS DAYS...AS A SFC LOW OVER THE DAKOTAS MOVES NEWD WITH TIME AND AN ATTENDANT COLD FRONT MOVES SEWD ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS. STRONG SPEED SHEAR OF 40-50 KT IN THE 0-6 KM LAYER WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES INITIALLY...WITH AN ASSOCIATED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. EVENTUAL UPSCALE GROWTH INTO BOWING CLUSTERS WILL BE POSSIBLE. THE TORNADO THREAT CURRENTLY APPEARS LOW GIVEN VEERED SWLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS PER AREA VWPS. HOWEVER...A SMALL AREA OF ELY SFC WINDS REMAINS ACROSS THE FRONT RANGE IN CO PER RECENT SFC OBSERVATIONS...SUGGESTING THE TORNADO THREAT ACROSS THIS AREA IS NON-ZERO. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS FOR POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...ESPECIALLY OVER NORTHEASTERN NEBRASKA...SOUTHEAST SOUTH DAKOTA AND NORTHWESTERN IOWA...WITH ALL SEVERE HAZARDS POSSIBLE. THE TORNADO RISK WILL LIKELY INCREASE WITH ANY SUPERCELL STORM THROUGH 02Z AS THE ENVIRONMENT BECOMES MORE FAVORABLE FOR LOW-LEVEL ROTATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCTD SVR STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG AND E OF A SFC CONFLUENCE ZONE EXTENDING FROM A SFC LOW OVER NERN SD S/SWWD ACROSS WRN PORTIONS OF WW AREA AT 2330Z. THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THE WW AREA REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE...AND 25-30 KTS OF MID-LEVEL FLOW HAS CONTRIBUTED TO EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 25 TO 35 KTS. LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS FORECAST TO INCREASE THROUGH EARLY EVENING ASSOCIATED WITH A NOCTURNALLY STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET/ASSOCIATED INCREASE IN WAA...WITH AN INCREASE IN TSTM COVERAGE EXPECTED PRIMARILY OVER NERN NEB...SERN SD AND FAR NWRN IA. VWP DATA FROM BOTH KFSD AND KOAX HAVE RECENTLY SAMPLED CURVED LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS AND 150-175 M2/S2 OF 0-1 KM SRH...AND THESE VALUES WILL INCREASE AS LOW-LEVEL FLOW STRENGTHENS. AS TSTM COVERAGE INCREASES...SUPERCELLS WILL BE THE DOMINANT CONVECTIVE MODE WITH ALL SVR HAZARDS POSSIBLE. TORNADO RISK WILL BE GREATEST ACROSS NERN NEB/FAR NWRN IA...INCLUDING THE POTENTIAL FOR A STRONG TORNADO. TSTMS OVER SRN PORTIONS OF THE WW AREA HAVE STRUGGLED THUS FAR...WHERE LATEST MESOANALYSIS REVEALS LINGERING CINH. MORE ISOLATED SVR DEVELOPMENT REMAINS POSSIBLE IN THIS AREA THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF WW VALID TIME AS LOW-LEVEL WAA INCREASES. ..BUNTING.. 06/06/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE WEATHER THREAT CONTINUES FOR REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF THE WATCH AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A WEAK FRONT EXTENDED SWWD FROM A DIFFUSE SFC LOW OVER SERN ND ACROSS NWRN PORTIONS OF WW AREA AT 0040Z. ALTHOUGH A COUPLE TSTMS BRIEFLY ATTAINED SVR LEVELS EARLIER...RECENT RADAR TRENDS SUGGEST NON-SEVERE CLUSTERS/SHORT LINES. DESPITE AMPLE SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED STORMS /EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR 30-40 KTS/ INSTABILITY REMAINS MODEST...AND TSTMS ARE IN THE PROCESS OF MOVING E OF REMAINING INSTABILITY AXIS. WITH THE ONSET OF DIURNAL COOLING...THE ENVIRONMENT WILL BECOME EVEN LESS SUPPORTIVE FOR MORE THAN AN ISOLATED/BRIEF SVR THREAT AHEAD OF THE FRONT ACROSS ERN PORTIONS OF THE WW AREA. ..BUNTING.. 06/07/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL AND WIND CONTINUES IN AND NEAR WW 264...WITH THE GREATEST NEAR-TERM THREAT ACROSS WESTERN KS...INCLUDING THE GOODLAND AREA BY 01Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0045Z...STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE TSTMS ARE ONGOING ACROSS MAINLY THE SRN HALF OF WW 264. A LONG-LIVED SUPERCELL MOVING INTO WRN KS HAS RECENTLY INTENSIFIED AND WILL POSE A RISK OF DAMAGING HAIL/WIND IN GOODLAND AROUND 01Z AS IT POTENTIALLY INTERACTS WITH A PLETHORA OF OUTFLOW AND/OR MIXING BOUNDARIES VISIBLE ON KGLD RADAR. AN OUTFLOW-DRIVEN CLUSTER OF TSTMS ACROSS ERN CO HAS BEEN SLOWLY INCREASING IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY AND MAY POSE A DAMAGING-WIND RISK INTO THE ERN PART OF WW 264 IF UPSCALE GROWTH CONTINUES. MEANWHILE...WINDS HAVE BACKED TO SELY NEAR THE FRONT RANGE IN COLORADO...WITH RESULTING UPSLOPE FLOW POTENTIALLY GENERATING REDEVELOPMENT FOR WRN PORTIONS OF WW 264 WITH A CONTINUED RISK OF HAIL/WIND...GIVEN SUFFICIENT BUOYANCY AND SHEAR NOTED ON 00Z DNR SOUNDING. ..DEAN.. 06/07/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW TORNADO WATCH WILL BE NEEDED FOR GENERALLY THE NORTHERN TWO-THIRDS OF CURRENT WATCH AREA AS SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE BEYOND THE 02Z EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NUMEROUS TSTMS...OCNLY SVR...CONTINUE ACROSS NERN NEB/SERN SD AT 01Z. THESE STORMS WILL MOVE INTO FAR ERN PORTIONS OF WW AREA THROUGH 02Z...AND WITH TSTMS FARTHER WEST ALONG AND IN ADVANCE OF AN EWD-MOVING COLD FRONT...A NEW WATCH WILL BE NEEDED PRIOR TO 02Z. THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THE NRN TWO-THIRDS OF THE WATCH AREA REMAINS FAVORABLE FOR A CONTINUED SVR THREAT...WITH MODERATE BUOYANCY AND 30-35 KTS OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR. LATEST VWP DATA FROM KOAX AND KFSD CONTINUE TO SHOW CURVED LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS WITH 0-1 KM SRH OF 200-300 M2/S2. INCREASING WAA ASSOCIATED WITH A STRENGTHENING LOW LEVEL JET WILL PROMOTE CONTINUED WIDESPREAD TSTM COVERAGE...WITH THE NUMBER OF STORMS/STORM-SCALE INTERACTIONS LIKELY TO INFLUENCE THE POTENTIAL SEVERITY. GIVEN THE LARGE-SCALE CONDITIONS WHICH ARE LIKELY TO REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR A SVR RISK...INCLUDING TORNADOES...A NEW TORNADO WATCH WILL BE COORDINATED PRIOR TO 02Z MAINLY NORTH OF INTERSTATE 80. ..BUNTING.. 06/07/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A BRIEF/ISOLATED STRONGER THUNDERSTORM MAY OCCUR THROUGH 05Z ACROSS THE REMAINING VALID PORTION OF WATCH. A DOWNSTREAM WATCH IS NOT EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW STRONGER TSTMS WERE LOCATED ALONG A COLD FRONT OVER STEARNS AND MORRISON COUNTIES IN CENTRAL MN AT 0325Z. BUOYANCY CONTINUES TO DIMINISH ACROSS THE REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WW AREA WITH NOCTURNAL COOLING...AND ALTHOUGH AN ISOLATED STRONGER STORM REMAINS POSSIBLE...THE OVERALL SEVERE THREAT REMAINS LOW. GIVEN OBSERVED RADAR AND SHORT-TERM ENVIRONMENTAL TRENDS...AN ADDITIONAL WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED. ..BUNTING.. 06/07/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STRONG THUNDERSTORM RISK LINGERS IN AND NEAR WW 264...BUT THE THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE TO SLOWLY DIMINISH WITH TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION CONTINUES ACROSS BOTH THE ERN AND WRN PARTS OF WW 264...THOUGH IT HAS BECOME LARGELY DISORGANIZED. LOCALLY GUSTY WINDS ARE STILL POSSIBLE AHEAD OF THE SMALL...LOOSELY ORGANIZED MCS MOVING ACROSS NWRN KS...WITH A 46 KT GUST RECENTLY OBSERVED AT COLBY KS. HOWEVER...WITH INCREASING CINH AND WEAK DEEP-LAYER SHEAR /AS OBSERVED FROM KGLD VWP/...A SUBSTANTIAL SEVERE THREAT IS NOT EXPECTED AS THIS SYSTEM MOVES E OUT OF WW 264 AND NO DOWNSTREAM WATCH IS ANTICIPATED. FURTHER WEST...CONVECTION PERSISTS E OF DENVER...WHERE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR OF AROUND 30-35 KTS /PER KFTG VWP/ IS A LITTLE MORE FAVORABLE COMPARED TO AREAS FURTHER EAST. WEAKENING SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY SHOULD CONTINUE TO LIMIT THE SEVERE THREAT ACROSS NERN CO...THOUGH ISOLATED INSTANCES OF HAIL ARE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST CORES. CONVECTION MAY LINGER FOR MUCH OF THE NIGHT AS PERTURBATIONS EMANATING FROM THE UPPER LOW OVER THE GREAT BASIN CONTINUE TO MOVE OVER THE AREA...BUT A GRADUAL DECREASE IN THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE. EARLY CANCELLATION OF WW 264 IS LIKELY IF WEAKENING TRENDS PERSIST. ..DEAN.. 06/07/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT WILL BE GREATEST OVER THE SOUTHERN HALF OF THE WATCH AREA...WHERE DAMAGING WINDS...LARGE HAIL AND A COUPLE TORNADOES REMAIN POSSIBLE. THE SEVERE RISK HAS LESSENED OVER NORTHERN PORTIONS OF THE WATCH AREA. A NEW WATCH IS LIKELY ACROSS PORTIONS OF WESTERN/CENTRAL IOWA BY 05Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTMS HAVE TRANSITIONED INTO A PRONOUNCED LINEAR STRUCTURE WITH A WELL DEVELOPED COLD POOL ACROSS NERN NEB/NWRN IA LATE THIS EVENING...AND LATEST RADAR DATA SUGGESTS A RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO WITH BRIEF LEADING-EDGE CIRCULATIONS. AS THE LINE OF TSTMS CONTINUES TO MOVE EAST...THE DOWNSTREAM ENVIRONMENT WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR A CONTINUED SVR RISK GIVEN MUCAPE OF 1000 TO 2000 J/KG AND A 40-50 KT LOW-LEVEL JET. THE PRIMARY RISK IS FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A BRIEF LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATION. WITH TIME THE THREAT WILL INCREASE TO THE E OF WW...AND THUS A NEW WATCH IS LIKELY PRIOR TO 05Z INTO PORTIONS OF CENTRAL IA. ACROSS ROUGHLY THE NRN HALF OF THE WW AREA...WIDESPREAD PRECIPITATION/COOLING HAS SUBSTANTIALLY STABILIZED THE ENVIRONMENT. LOCALLY HEAVY RAINFALL/FLASH FLOODING REMAINS A THREAT THERE AND FARTHER SOUTH ACROSS NERN NEB/NWRN IA...REFERENCE WPC MESOSCALE PRECIPITATION DISCUSSION 180 FOR DETAILS. ..BUNTING.. 06/07/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS A LIMITED PORTION OF IOWA THIS MORNING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A WELL-DEFINED MCS CONTINUES TO DEVELOP EWD ACROSS WW 266 WITH MCV CENTERED OVER NRN IA AND A SQUALL LINE EXTENDING SWWD INTO CNTRL IA. RECENT SURFACE OBSERVATIONS SUGGEST THE LINE IS NON-SEVERE IN A BROAD SENSE...WITH WIDESPREAD 30-40 KT GUSTS. HOWEVER...LOCALIZED SEVERE GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE. IN ADDITION...RADAR TRENDS HAVE SHOWN AREAS OF ROTATION WITHIN THE LINE ESPECIALLY OVER CNTRL IA IN CLOSER PROXIMITY TO THE HIGHER DEWPOINTS AND A SHORT-LIVED AND LIKELY WEAK TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. THEREAFTER...THIS SYSTEM WILL PROGRESSIVELY ENCOUNTER A MORE STABLE AIR MASS AND MAY BECOME A BIT ELEVATED EXCEPT FOR THE TRAILING SW PORTION OF THE LINE ACROSS SRN IA. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE ORIENTATION OF THAT PART OF THE LINE...ANY SEVERE WEATHER THREAT SHOULD BE MINIMAL. ..JEWELL.. 06/07/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
